name: board-pack
title: Board pack
for_each: select id, name from entities where active order by name

sections.title: Where the year lands
sections.note: Actuals to the last closed month plus the current forecast, against the approved budget. A positive gap is better than budget.
sections.sql: select code, account, actual_to_date, forecast_rest, outlook, budget, gap from v_outlook where entity_id = $1 order by code

sections.title: Last month against budget
sections.sql: select month, code, account, actual, budget, variance, pct, explained from v_variance where entity_id = $1 order by abs(variance) desc

sections.title: What the budget holders said
sections.sql: select a.code, a.name as account, c.note, c.actor as by from commentary c join accounts a on a.id = c.account_id join v_latest m on m.entity_id = c.entity_id and c.period = m.last_actual where c.entity_id = $1 order by a.code

sections.title: Cash
sections.sql: select month, basis, closing_cash from v_cash where entity_id = $1 and period >= (select last_actual from v_latest where entity_id = $1) - interval '2 months' order by period

sections.title: Bank covenants
sections.sql: select lender, metric, test, threshold, last_tested, last_value, last_passed, first_forecast_breach, breach_value from v_covenants where entity_id = $1

sections.title: People
sections.sql: select role, person, status, starts_on, ends_on, annual_salary, oncost_rate, cost_in_forecast from v_headcount where entity_id = $1 and status <> 'cancelled' order by starts_on

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule, item, finding from v_compliance where item like '%' || (select name from entities where id = $1) || '%' order by rule

name: covenant-certificate
title: Covenant compliance certificate (draft)
for_each: select distinct e.id, e.name from entities e join covenants c on c.entity_id = e.id where c.active order by e.name

sections.title: Tests on the last closed quarter or month
sections.note: Check each figure against the definitions in the facility agreement before a director signs.
sections.sql: select distinct on (covenant_id) lender, metric, test, threshold, month as tested, value, passes from v_covenant_tests where entity_id = $1 and basis = 'actual' order by covenant_id, period desc

sections.title: The next twelve months on the current forecast
sections.sql: select lender, metric, month, value, passes from v_covenant_tests where entity_id = $1 and basis = 'forecast' order by metric, period

sections.title: Signature
sections.sql: select 'Signed for and on behalf of the borrower by a director' as statement, '' as name, '' as signature, '' as date where $1::text is not null

name: solvency-certificate
title: Distribution and solvency working paper (draft)
for_each: select d.id, e.name || ' ' || d.pay_on as name from distributions d join entities e on e.id = d.entity_id where d.status <> 'cancelled' order by d.pay_on

sections.title: The distribution
sections.sql: select entity, country, currency, amount, status, declared_on, pay_on, approved_by, solvency_certificate_on, in_forecast from v_distributions where id = $1

sections.title: Balance sheet at the last closed month
sections.sql: select to_char(m.period, 'YYYY-MM') as month, m.assets, m.liabilities, m.assets - m.liabilities as net_assets from v_monthly m join distributions d on d.entity_id = m.entity_id where d.id = $1 and m.basis = 'actual' and m.assets is not null order by m.period desc limit 1

sections.title: Forecast cash for twelve months from payment
sections.note: Lowest point after paying, unless the forecast already includes the payment.
sections.sql: select c.month, c.basis, c.closing_cash, c.closing_cash - case when d.in_forecast then 0 else d.amount end as after_distribution from v_cash c join distributions d on d.entity_id = c.entity_id where d.id = $1 and c.period >= date_trunc('month', d.pay_on) and c.period < date_trunc('month', d.pay_on) + interval '12 months' order by c.period

sections.title: The rule this supports
sections.sql: select case e.country when 'NZ' then 'Companies Act 1993 s52: the board must be satisfied on reasonable grounds that the company will meet the solvency test (s4) immediately after the distribution, and every director who votes for it signs a certificate saying so.' else 'Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) s254T: a dividend only if assets exceed liabilities immediately before it is declared and the excess is enough to pay it, it is fair and reasonable to shareholders as a whole, and it does not materially prejudice the ability to pay creditors.' end as rule, 'A working paper for the directors, not legal advice.' as note from distributions d join entities e on e.id = d.entity_id where d.id = $1
